text:
Type: beige curtains with tie-backs, pair
Use: framing windows, dimming light, adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: medium-weight woven fabric with a soft sheen, matching fabric tie-backs, hidden tabs
Colors: warm taupe beige, light greige
Shape: two long panels hung on a rod in even pleats, gathered at mid-height by tie-backs into an hourglass drape, floor length, soft medium weight
Feel: warm, elegant, cozy, calm
Goes with: cream walls, warm wood, brass, neutral sofas; classic, traditional or farmhouse rooms

product.name: BLEKVIVA
product.description: The densely woven curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
